title: Reading The Market - Supply And Demand 2
author: ReadTheMarket.com

long_entries.rule: Price returns to fresh demand zone (RBR or DBR)
Bullish engulfing candle at demand zone
Quasimodo bullish pattern completed at S/D zone
Diamond pattern at bottom with demand confirmation
CanCan pattern bullish reversal at demand zone
3Drive bullish pattern completed with FTR confirmation
Compression bottom breakout with strong bullish candle
Failure to Return (FTR) to broken demand = continuation long

short_entries.rule: Price returns to fresh supply zone (RBD or DBD)
Bearish engulfing candle at supply zone
Quasimodo bearish pattern completed at S/D zone
Diamond pattern at top with supply confirmation
CanCan pattern bearish reversal at supply zone
3Drive bearish pattern completed with FTR confirmation
Compression top breakdown with strong bearish candle
Failure to Return (FTR) to broken supply = continuation short
